arxiv-2008-12284.title: learn2learn : A Library for Meta-Learning Research
arxiv-2008-12284.creator: Sébastien M. R. Arnold, Praateek Mahajan, Debajyoti Datta, Ian Bunner, Konstantinos Saitas Zarkias
arxiv-2008-12284.description: Abstract Meta-learning researchers face two fundamental issues in their empirical work: prototyping and reproducibility. Researchers are prone to make mistakes when prototyping new algorithms and tasks because modern meta-learning methods rely on unconventional functionalities of machine learning frameworks. In turn, reproducing existing results becomes a tedious endeavour – a situation exacerbated by the lack of standardized implementations and benchmarks.

arxiv-2204-10288.creator: Joy Christian
arxiv-2204-10288.description: Abstract Using the powerful language of geometric algebra, we present an observationally symmetric derivation of the strong correlations predicted by the entangled singlet state in a deterministic and locally causal model, usually also referred to as a local-realistic model, in which the physical space is assumed to be a quaternionic 3-sphere, or S 3 S^{3} , available as the spatial

arxiv-2212-12711.title: The Cauchy-Dirichlet problem for parabolic deformed Hermitian-Yang-Mills equation
arxiv-2212-12711.creator: Liding Huang, Jiaogen Zhang
arxiv-2212-12711.description: Abstract . The purpose of this paper is to investigate the parabolic deformed Hermitian-Yang-Mills equation with hypercritical phase in a smooth domain Ω ⊂ ℂ n \Omega\subset\mathbb{C}^{n} . By using J J -functional, we are able to prove the convergence of solutions. As an application, we give an alternative proof of the Dirichlet problem for deformed Hermitian-Yang-Mills equation.

arxiv-2302-14625.title: mmSense: Detecting Concealed Weapons with a Miniature Radar Sensor
arxiv-2302-14625.creator: Kevin Mitchell † § \sthanks We acknowledge funding from the QuantIC Project funded by the EPSRC Quantum Technology Programme (grant EP/MO1326X/1), and Google. Khaled Kassem † § Chaitanya Kaul ‡ § Valentin Kapitany † Philip Binner † Andrew Ramsay ‡ Roderick Murray-Smith ‡ Daniele Faccio †
arxiv-2302-14625.description: Abstract For widespread adoption, public security and surveillance systems must be accurate, portable, compact, and real-time, without impeding the privacy of the individuals being observed. Current systems broadly fall into two categories – image-based which are accurate, but lack privacy, and RF signal-based, which preserve privacy but lack portability, compactness and accuracy.

arxiv-2303-01608.title: Discrete-time quantum walk dispersion control through long-range correlations
arxiv-2303-01608.creator: A. R. C. Buarque 1,2, F. S. Passos 2, W. S. Dias 3, E. P. Raposo 1
arxiv-2303-01608.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. R. C. Buarque 1,2, F. S. Passos 2, W. S. Dias 3, E. P. Raposo 1. We investigate the evolution dynamics of inhomogeneous discrete-time one-dimensional quantum walks displaying long-range correlations in both space and time. The associated quantum coin operators are built to exhibit a random inhomogeneity distribution of long-range correlations embedded in the time evolution protocol through a fractional Brownian motion with spectrum following a power-law behavior, S ⁡ ( k ) ∼ 1 / k ν S(k)\sim 1/k^{\nu} .

arxiv-2305-14424.title: Cloud Atlas: Navigating the Multiphase Landscape of Tempestuous Galactic Winds 2023 Cloud Atlas: Navigating the Multiphase Landscape of Tempestuous Galactic Winds – 37
arxiv-2305-14424.creator: Brent Tan & Drummond B. Fielding
arxiv-2305-14424.description: Abstract Galaxies comprise intricate networks of interdependent processes which together govern their evolution. Central among these are the multiplicity of feedback channels, which remain incompletely understood. One outstanding problem is the understanding and modeling of the multiphase nature of galactic winds, which play a crucial role in galaxy formation and evolution.

arxiv-2305-15687.title: Singularities of divisors of small degrees on abelian varieties
arxiv-2305-15687.creator: Zhi Jiang, Hui Liu
arxiv-2305-15687.description: Abstract . Pareschi showed that an ample divisor of degree d d on a simple abelian variety of dimension g g has mild singularities when d < g d<g . We extend his result to general polarized abelian varieties. We also show that ample divisors of degree 3 3 or 4 4 on an abelian variety have mild singularities.

arxiv-2306-04574.title: The Effect of Length on Key Fingerprint Verification Security and Usability Conference: The 18th International Conference on Availability, Reliability and Security; August 29 – September 1, 2023; Benevento, Italy The 18th International Conference on Availability, Reliability and Security (ARES 2023)
arxiv-2306-04574.creator: Dan Turner, Siamak F. Shahandashti, Helen Petrie
arxiv-2306-04574.description: Abstract . In applications such as end-to-end encrypted instant messaging, secure email, and device pairing, users need to compare key fingerprints to detect impersonation and adversary-in-the-middle attacks. Key fingerprints are usually computed as truncated hashes of each party’s view of the channel keys, encoded as an alphanumeric or numeric string, and compared out-of-band, e.g. manually, to detect any inconsistencies.

arxiv-2309-16156.title: On Steinerberger Curvature and Graph Distance Matrices Present address: Department of Mathematics, Iowa State University, Ames, IA, 50011, United States Present email: wcchen@iastate.edu
arxiv-2309-16156.creator: Wei-Chia Chen and Mao-Pei Tsui
arxiv-2309-16156.description: Abstract . Steinerberger proposed a notion of curvature on graphs involving the graph distance matrix (J. Graph Theory, 2023). We show that nonnegative curvature is almost preserved under three graph operations. We characterize the distance matrix and its null space after adding an edge between two graphs.

arxiv-2406-06131.title: Building Bridges: A Dataset for Evaluating Gender-Fair Machine Translation into German
arxiv-2406-06131.creator: Manuel Lardelli, Giuseppe Attanasio, Anne Lauscher University of Graz, Austria Instituto de Telecomunicações, Lisbon, Portugal University of Hamburg, Germany manuel.lardelli01@gmail.com
arxiv-2406-06131.description: Abstract The translation of gender-neutral person-referring terms (e.g., the students ) is often non-trivial. Translating from English into German poses an interesting case—in German, person-referring nouns are usually gender-specific, and if the gender of the referent(s) is unknown or diverse, the generic masculine ( die Studenten (m.) ) is commonly used.

arxiv-2503-08267.title: Explainable Autoencoder Design for RSSI-Based Multi-User Beam Probing and Hybrid Precoding
arxiv-2503-08267.creator: Asmaa Abdallah, , Abdulkadir Celik, , Ahmed Alkhateeb, , and Ahmed M. Eltawil
arxiv-2503-08267.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel neural network (NN) structure referred to as an “Auto-hybrid precoder” (Auto-HP) and an unsupervised deep learning (DL) approach that jointly designs millimeter wave probing beams and hybrid precoding matrix design for mmWave multi-user communication system with minimal training pilots.

arxiv-2503-14842.title: Comparative Analysis of Hall Effect Implementations in Hall-Magnetohydrodynamics
arxiv-2503-14842.creator: Kazunari Iwasaki, Kengo Tomida
arxiv-2503-14842.description: Abstract There is no standard numerical implementation of the Hall effect, which is one of the non-ideal magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) effects. Numerical instability arises when a simple implementation is used, in which the Hall electric field is added to the electric field to update magnetic fields without further modifications to the numerical scheme.

arxiv-2504-18940.title: Anisotropy-dependent decay of room temperature metastable skyrmions and a nascent double- q q spin texture in Co 8 Zn 9 Mn 3
arxiv-2504-18940.description: Abstract Chiral cubic Co-Zn-Mn magnets exhibit diverse topological spin textures, including room-temperature skyrmion phases and robust far-from-equilibrium metastable states. Despite recent advances in understanding metastable skyrmions, the interplay between compositional disorder and varying magnetic anisotropy on the stability and decay of metastable textures, particularly near room temperature, remains incompletely understood.

arxiv-2506-23900.title: Accurate Mediterranean Sea forecasting via graph-based deep learning
arxiv-2506-23900.creator: Daniel Holmberg, Emanuela Clementi, Italo Epicoco, Teemu Roos
arxiv-2506-23900.description: Abstract Accurate ocean forecasting systems are essential for understanding marine dynamics, which play a crucial role in sectors such as shipping, aquaculture, environmental monitoring, and coastal risk management. Traditional numerical solvers, while effective, are computationally expensive and time-consuming. Recent advancements in machine learning have revolutionized weather forecasting, offering fast and energy-efficient alternatives.

arxiv-2508-14184.title: A Bayesian Semiparametric Mixture Model for Clustering Zero-Inflated Microbiome Data
arxiv-2508-14184.creator: Suppapat Korsurat and Matthew D. Koslovsky
arxiv-2508-14184.description: Abstract Abstract. Microbiome research has immense potential for unlocking insights into human health and disease. A common goal in human microbiome research is identifying subgroups of individuals with similar microbial composition that may be linked to specific health states or environmental exposures.

arxiv-2602-08377.title: Reinforcement Learning with Backtracking Feedback
arxiv-2602-08377.creator: Bilgehan Sel, Vaishakh Keshava, Phillip Wallis, Lukas Rutishauser, Ming Jin, Dingcheng Li
arxiv-2602-08377.description: Abstract Addressing the critical need for robust safety in Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly against adversarial attacks and in-distribution errors, we introduce Reinforcement Learning with Backtracking Feedback (RLBF). This framework advances upon prior methods, such as BSAFE, by primarily leveraging a Reinforcement Learning (RL) stage where models learn to dynamically correct their own generation errors.

britannica-1911-pepper.title: Pepper (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-pepper.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-pepper.description: Article 'Pepper' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Black pepper is the dried fruit of piper nigrum, a perennial climbing shrub indigenous to the forests of Travancore and Malabar, from whence it has been introduced into Java, Sumatra, Borneo, the Malay Peninsula, Siam, the Philippines, and the West Indies. It climbs on tree-trunks by roots in the same way as ivy, and from its climbing habit is known as the pepper vine.

pmc-11320858.creator: Tyler J. Wenzel, Joseph D. Desjarlais, Darrell D. Mousseau
pmc-11320858.description: BackgroundAlzheimer disease (AD) is a heterogenous and multifactorial disease, and its pathology is partly driven by microglia and their activated phenotype. Brain organoids (BOs) are gaining prominence as a relevant model of the human brain for the study of AD; however, BOs are commonly devoid of microglia.

pmc-13367365.title: Artemin Serves as a Novel Predictive Biomarker and Exerts a Protective Effect Against Preterm Birth
pmc-13367365.creator: Jie Zhang, Shiwei Mei, Yingying Li, Huiwen Yu, Xiaochun Yi, Jing Jin, Li Zhang, Yijia Wang, Zixia Mai, Guocheng Liu
pmc-13367365.description: BackgroundPreterm birth (PTB) is a major cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality and is closely associated with dysregulated inflammatory responses at the maternal–fetal interface. Excessive activation of inflammatory signaling pathways often represents a terminal event in PTB, highlighting the need to identify upstream immunoregulatory factors involved in disease pathogenesis.

pmc-13689199.creator: Maryam Latifian, Sahar Esmaeili, Ronak Mihan
pmc-13689199.description: BackgroundIn recent years, humanistic approaches have gained considerable popularity in treating individuals with psychiatric disorders and comorbid substance use disorders. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of existential group psychotherapy in reducing perceived rejection and anxiety in this population.
